Mission Local’s four data takeaways were: turnout was lower than in 2020 despite a similar number of registered voters; Proposition H moved some races to even-year elections, when turnout is higher; voters in districts near the Great Highway strongly opposed Proposition K, though it passed citywide 55–45; and campaign fundraising did not prevent a measure’s rejection by 13 percent. In new precincts, 52 percent of first-choice votes went to Philhour.
